plugins.name: feature-workflow
plugins.description: Feature lifecycle management with external review gates. Capture ideas, plan, review plans and implementations via draft PRs (with optional automated review by Gemini or Codex on GitHub Actions), and ship. Directory-based features with status determined by file presence and an auto-generated DASHBOARD.md.

plugins.name: website-deployment
plugins.description: Guided workflow to deploy Node.js/Express apps to AWS serverless architecture. Analyzes your app, scaffolds infrastructure, and deploys with CDK — all with step-by-step explanations for beginners.

plugins.name: sprint-planner
plugins.description: Sprint planning and team coordination. Triage backlogs by deadline, assign work with self-service specs, audit feature specs for completeness, and generate team communication. Designed for small teams with mixed experience levels.
